connectors.name: PKULaw · Legal Search
connectors.summary: Statutes / provisions / judicial case search and citation verification
connectors.description: Access PKULaw's laws and regulations, judicial cases, statutory provision recognition and citation verification. Requires a PKULaw Access Token; some services may need to be activated or purchased separately.

promptVariables.name: citation
promptVariables.label: Legal citation
promptVariables.placeholder: e.g. 《民法典》第五百七十七条

prompts.title: Statute and provision search
prompts.text: Use the PKULaw MCP to find the currently effective laws and regulations related to "{{topic}}", and give the verbatim text and validity information

prompts.title: Typical judicial cases
prompts.text: Use the PKULaw MCP to find typical judicial cases related to "{{caseTopic}}", and list the case numbers and holdings

prompts.title: Citation recognition
prompts.text: Use the PKULaw MCP to identify and verify the standard source of {{citation}} and the currently effective statutory text

prompts.title: Citation verification
prompts.text: Use the PKULaw MCP to verify whether {{citation}} is accurate, and explain its current validity status

connectors.name: Wind · Stock Data
connectors.summary: Global stock profiles / market quotes / technical indicators / financials and corporate events
connectors.description: Access the Wind stock data service, covering company profiles, share capital and shareholders, market quotes, technical indicators, fundamentals, financial statements, corporate events, and risk and volatility data. Requires a Wind Key; the available service scopes depend on what your Wind account actually has enabled.

prompts.title: Company profile and industry
prompts.text: Use the Wind stock data MCP to look up the company profile, main business and industry of {{stock}}

prompts.title: Latest quote
prompts.text: Use the Wind stock data MCP to look up the latest price, volume, turnover rate and bid/ask quotes for {{stock}}

prompts.title: Technical and volatility indicators
prompts.text: Use the Wind stock data MCP to look up the MACD, RSI, volatility and price change of {{stock}} over the last 20 trading days

prompts.title: Core financial metrics
prompts.text: Use the Wind stock data MCP to look up the revenue, net profit, ROE and cash flow of {{stock}} for the latest reporting period
